title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: No more errors on files you cannot open
summary: A source jar from the Gradle cache opens with languageId java, and three diagnostic providers gated on the language alone.

highlights.title: A source jar is not project code
highlights.description: Kotlin Jump put an ERROR inside `databinding-runtime-9.3.1-sources.jar`, in a file the reader can neither open nor fix. The scheme and the workspace folder are both checked now.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Three diagnostic providers scanned any document whose language looked right, including a source jar from the Gradle cache.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The test doubles for a document URI carried only `toString()`, so four regression tests were passing on a URI that could not exist.
The VS Code test double answered that no workspace folder contains anything. A folder is open by default now, which is the ordinary case.
